instructions: A small notes server. Notes are stored locally and never leave this machine.

tools.name: add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: Save a note with a title and body. Returns the new note's id.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Search saved notes by keyword. Use add_note first if there are no notes yet.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete note
tools.description: Delete a note by id. Ask the user to confirm before deleting.

prompts.name: weekly_summary
prompts.description: Summarize this week's notes as a short bulleted list for the user.

resources.name: index
resources.description: Ids and titles of all saved notes.
